name: Learned dynamics
summary: Replace part of the explicit simulator with a learned component while keeping the rest differentiable. The first concrete step toward structured generative worlds.

tasks.title: Learn a residual correction to the grid update
tasks.note: Keep the MLS-MPM step but add a small learned residual on the grid velocity, trained through the differentiable rollout. A minimal hybrid that tests whether gradients can train a network embedded in physics.

tasks.title: One latent-conditioned network for all four materials
tasks.note: One network, one shared weight set, learns ALL FOUR canonical materials, with each material designated by a compact latent code fed in as input. Taichi only -- no WebGPU needed. The seam is the PER-PARTICLE constitutive model (stress + plastic state), not the grid update. T-022 bounds the deployable size at roughly a width-16 MLP, so the open question this task answers is CAPACITY: can something that small hold four structurally different materials? Train across scenes with each material alone and scenes where they mix and interact.
